/** * 컴슬러관리 화면 리스트 */
SELECT A.ENFSN_NO AS ENFSN_NO, MAX(C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS CNSLTNT_NM, MAX(E.USER_ID) AS CNSLTNT_ID, MAX(D.NCKN_NM) AS CNSLTNT_NCKN, NVL( MAX(A.SUBJCT_NM), MAX(F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM)) AS MAJOR_NM, LISTAGG(NVL(B.ENFSN_NTN_CERTI_SE_ETC_CN, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM),',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY B.ENFSN_NTN_CERTI_SE_CD) AS CERTI_NM, MAX(E.FRST_REG_DT) AS REG_DT, MAX(A.INDCT_YN) AS INDCT_YN FROM AKA600 A, AKA610 B, SAC100 C, SCA100 D, SAA200 E, SAC100 F WHERE 1=1 AND A.CNTER_INST_NO = '1000000947' AND A.ENFSN_NO = D.ENFSN_NO AND A.ENFSN_NO = E.ENFSN_NO AND A.ENFSN_NO = B.ENFSN_NO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'ENFSN_NTN_CERTI_SE_CD' AND C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = B.ENFSN_NTN_CERTI_SE_CD AND F.CMMNS_CD_ID (+)= 'EMPMN_INFO_MAJOR_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+)= A.EMPMN_INFO_MAJOR_SE_CD
AND A.INDCT_YN = #{INDCT_YN}
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NM} || '%'
AND E.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_ID} || '%'
AND D.NCKN_NM LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NCKN} || '%'
GROUP BY A.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY CNSLTNT_NM
mapper.update: UPDATE AKA600 SET INDCT_YN = #{INDCT_YN} WHERE 1=1 AND ENFSN_NO = #{ENFSN_NO}
